item_description:
Script: dpe tshugs.
Some corrections in dbu can
Two sets of folio numbers, from 1 to 10 and from 301 to 310.
Signature slightly faded on the cover page.
Only the vowels are legible on the reproduction for the first verse on fol. 1b1 and the author's name in the colophon on fol. 10b6 - the consonants are presumably written in color on the original.
